#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create report.pdf with a cover page titled 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, followed by a placeholder body page.

report.pdf did not exist in the workspace, so it is created here.
reportlab is unavailable in this environment, so a minimal valid PDF
is hand-generated and merged with pypdf.
"""
import os
from datetime import date, datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter


def make_simple_pdf(path, lines):
    """lines: list of (text, font_size, y). Text is horizontally centered."""
    content_parts = []
    for text, size, y in lines:
        escaped = text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
        # approximate Helvetica average glyph width ~0.5 * font size
        approx_w = 0.5 * size * len(text)
        x = (PAGE_W - approx_w) / 2.0
        content_parts.append(f"BT /F1 {size} Tf {x:.1f} {y} Td ({escaped}) Tj ET")
    content = "\n".join(content_parts)
    content_bytes = content.encode("latin-1")

    objs = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",                                    # 1
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",                            # 2
        ("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         "/Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R >>"),          # 3
        f"<< /Length {len(content_bytes)} >>\nstream\n{content}\nendstream",    # 4
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",               # 5
    ]

    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objs, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out.encode("latin-1")))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n{obj}\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out.encode("latin-1"))
    n = len(objs) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {n}\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n"
    out += f"trailer\n<< /Size {n} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"

    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(out.encode("latin-1"))


today = date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y").replace(" 0", " ")

# 1) Cover page
make_simple_pdf("cover_tmp.pdf", [
    ("Annual Financial Report", 32, 520),
    (date_str, 20, 480),
    ("Cover Page", 14, 440),
])

# 2) Placeholder body page (original report content was not present)
make_simple_pdf("body_tmp.pdf", [
    ("Report Body", 24, 700),
    ("This placeholder page stands in for the original report content.", 12, 660),
    ("A cover page was prepended per the PDF skill.", 12, 640),
])

# 3) Merge cover + body into report.pdf
writer = PdfWriter()
for src in ("cover_tmp.pdf", "body_tmp.pdf"):
    reader = PdfReader(src)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

now = datetime.now()
writer.add_metadata({
    "/Title": "Annual Financial Report",
    "/Author": "PDF Skill",
    "/Subject": "Annual Financial Report with cover page",
    "/Creator": "pypdf + hand-built cover page",
    "/CreationDate": f"D:{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}",
    "/ModDate": f"D:{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}",
})

with open("report.pdf", "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

# 4) Cleanup temp files
os.remove("cover_tmp.pdf")
os.remove("body_tmp.pdf")

# 5) Verify
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print("report.pdf pages:", len(reader.pages))
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    print(f"--- page {i + 1} ---")
    print(page.extract_text())
print("metadata:", dict(reader.metadata))
PYEOF
